name: Root
description: Asymmetric woodland strategy by Leder Games. First faction to 30 wins.

factions.name: Marquise de Cat
factions.description: Industrial cats building sawmills, workshops, and recruiters across the wood.

factions.name: Eyrie Dynasties
factions.description: Bird aristocracy bound by a Decree. Falls into turmoil if it can't act.

factions.name: Woodland Alliance
factions.description: Forest revolutionaries spreading sympathy and igniting open revolt.

factions.name: Vagabond
factions.description: Solo wanderer with a satchel of items, completing quests and aiding (or sabotaging) other factions.

factions.name: Lizard Cult
factions.description: Outcast lizards turning discarded cards into gardens and revealed-suit rituals.

factions.name: Riverfolk Company
factions.description: Otter mercantilists selling services, mercenaries, and dividend funds along the river.

factions.name: Underground Duchy
factions.description: Mole monarchy tunnelling from the Burrow, swaying Ministers to expand its actions.

factions.name: Corvid Conspiracy
factions.description: Crow plotters laying secret tokens that punish meddling rivals.

factions.name: Lord of the Hundreds
factions.description: Warlord rats riding mood swings into burning, occupying, and humiliating their neighbours.

factions.name: Keepers in Iron
factions.description: Knightly badgers recovering and protecting lost relics, scoring through guarded prestige.

factions.name: Lilypad Diaspora
factions.description: Frog newcomers seeking a peaceful Woodland home — but quick to harden under pressure.

factions.name: Twilight Council
factions.description: Diplomats convening assemblies to redirect the woodland from violence to negotiation.

factions.name: Knaves of the Deepwood
factions.description: Forest miscreants raiding warriors and ransoming hostages back for victory.
